[[File:Gibbela.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The farm on Gibbela]]
A [[Dazouri]]<ref name="Shapeshifters">{{SW|url=news/hiding-in-plain-sight-star-wars-shapeshifters|text=Hiding in Plain Sight: ''Star Wars'' Shapeshifters|int=Hiding in Plain Sight: Star Wars Shapeshifters|nolive=1}}</ref> individual maintained a '''farm''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gibbela]]. When an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] detachment arrived at the [[Farm/Legends|farm]] with the intention of claiming the planet for the Empire, the Dazouri [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] transformed into a large, ferocious [[Death/Legends|killer]] and wiped out the Imperial force. Subsequently, the farmer repurposed the Imperials' leftover equipment as farming tools, adapting their [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] as another building at the farm.<ref name="Tales19">{{Tales|19|The Value of Proper Intelligence to Any Successful Military Campaign is Not to Be Underestimated}}</ref>
